comparison.objective: Install a rigid rack bracket, versus mount the final section of a bicycle tire bead.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid feature registration versus coordinated deformation, bead-channel management, and bimanual rolling without a lever.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket engagement/self-support versus bead fully seated without prohibited lever use or damage.
comparison.reason: The PR tests deformable manipulation that the rigid bracket task does not.
